BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
WITH RECURSIVE
synthetic AS (SELECT jsonb_build_object('agent_wakeup_requests', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT "agent_id","company_id","id","run_id","source" FROM public."agent_wakeup_requests" WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005') r),
'agents', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT "company_id","id","name" FROM public."agents" WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002') r),
'companies', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT "id","issue_prefix","name" FROM public."companies" WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001') r),
'heartbeat_run_events', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT "agent_id","company_id","event_type","id","payload","run_id","seq" FROM public."heartbeat_run_events" WHERE id = '6') r),
'heartbeat_runs', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT "agent_id","company_id","id","issue_id","wakeup_request_id" FROM public."heartbeat_runs" WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004') r),
'issue_recovery_actions', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT "cause","company_id","fingerprint","id","kind","next_action","owner_agent_id","source_issue_id" FROM public."issue_recovery_actions" WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007') r),
'issues', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT "assignee_agent_id","company_id","execution_run_id","id","title" FROM public."issues" WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003') r)) AS rows)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows', rows)::text FROM synthetic;
COMMIT;
